summary: [[character:riker]] spends three fruitless hours negotiating with [[character:george-butterworth|Colonel Butterworth]] for food aid to survivor groups whose supplies were destroyed by [[organization:vehement]] attacks, leaving them out of food with half the winter still to go. The [[organization:united-states-of-eurasia]] encampment, the [[organization:free-american-independent-theocratic-hegemony]] enclave, and the Spits hold the richest reserves but refuse to share, and the Spits' own surpluses are dwindling. [[character:homer]] warns that the climate is not improving and wonders whether space stations could help if approached differently, until drone telemetry shows that [[character:arthur]] has been killed by a booby-trapped nuclear detonation while working on wreckage near [[location:saturn]]. Arthur kept no backup off his ship, and Riker regrets never building backup storage into the [[location:sol]] space station. After mourning, Riker has Homer's drones recover what they can, decides that a fourth [[character:bob-replicant]] and a backup storage matrix are needed, and accepts Homer's suggestion to use the printers from his Earth-scavenging operations instead of reworking the schedule with the colonel. He sends [[character:bill]] an In Memoriam entry about Arthur for the archives and plans a wake for when [[character:charles]] is back in [[location:earth]] orbit.

updates.current_state: Killed by a booby-trapped nuclear detonation while working on wreckage near [[location:saturn]], with no backup stored off his ship.

At [[location:sol]], mourning [[character:arthur]] after failing to win food aid for starving survivor groups. He plans to make a fourth [[character:bob-replicant]] with the printers from [[character:homer]]'s Earth-scavenging operations and to build backup storage.

Running Earth-scavenging operations whose printers he has offered for making a fourth [[character:bob-replicant]] without reworking the schedule. After reporting [[character:arthur]]'s death from drone telemetry, he is having the drones recover what they can.
Away from [[location:earth]] orbit; a wake for [[character:arthur]] is planned for his return.
Locked in a combative, fruitless negotiation with [[character:riker]] over food aid for survivor groups left without food by [[organization:vehement]] attacks.

updates.description: VEHEMENT is an anonymous movement that advocates human extinction. It threatens violence and guerrilla tactics to coerce people into ending reproduction, with reported incidents appearing opportunistic and geographically dispersed. It has also attacked food production and supply facilities, most often as token gestures that amount to statements.
updates.current_state: Its latest three attacks destroyed food supplies that the targeted survivor groups could not spare, leaving them out of food or nearly so with half the winter remaining.

One of the survivor groups with the richest food reserves, it refuses to share them and is stretching its resources as far as it can. Its annual surpluses are shrinking fast, and [[character:riker]] expects it to become a have-not within a few years.

updates.state: About fifteen million survivors, many living on reserves, face a worsening climate, spreading radioactivity and starvation; equatorial farms would last perhaps twenty years. Much refined metal remains.
